My Hero Academia is a Japanese manga series by Kōhei Horikoshi, serialized in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2014 to 2024, following Izuku Midoriya, a boy born without superpowers ("Quirks") in a world where they are common, who dreams of becoming a superhero and inherits a power from the #1 hero, All Might, to attend U.A. High School. The series, which has inspired anime, video games, and spin-offs, concluded with 42 volumes and is known for its superhero-centric world and character development.
